title: LeWAM: End-to-End World and Action Modeling with JEPAs
abstract: arXiv:2610.12818v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn compact latent world models without pixel reconstruction. Existing JEPA pipelines typically train visual representations and action-conditioned dynamics before adding a control policy or solver. We introduce LeWAM, an end-to-end JEPA for control with: (1) a joint training objective over next latent state prediction and action flow matching, and (2) an isotropic Gaussian constraint on the latent state, enabling a single model to support direct policy execution and efficient planning by evaluating sampled actions with its learned latent dynamics. Compared with prior JEPAs in visual planning, LeWAM improves success rate from 28.6% to 89.7% on contact-rich tasks and from 10.9% to 46.2% on long-horizon tasks, and plans 32.3 times faster. tldr: LeWAM提出了一种端到端的JEPA控制框架，通过联合训练潜在状态预测与动作流匹配并对潜在状态施加各向同性高斯约束，使单一模型同时支持策略执行与高效规划，将接触密集任务和长时程任务的成功率大幅提升，并实现32.3倍的规划加速。
en_tdlr: LeWAM is an end-to-end JEPA for control that jointly trains latent state prediction and action flow matching with an isotropic Gaussian constraint, enabling a single model to support both direct policy execution and efficient planning, boosting success rates on contact-rich and long-horizon tasks while planning 32.3x faster.
